caption: A rower pulls an oar from the water, the blade dripping water back into the lake. .
positive_analysis:
As the rower lifts the paddle blade from the water, droplets detach and fall downward.
Gravity pulls the water clinging to the blade back into the lake surface.
The paddle's upward motion separates the blade from the water, exposing dripping edges.

negative_analysis:
Paddler strokes -> kayak glides forward across the calm lake surface.
Paddle blades lift from water -> droplets fall back into the lake.
Kayak hull displaces water -> ripples spread outward behind the boat.
Paddler shifts weight -> kayak rocks gently on the water surface.
